segments.text: VNto thee (O God) doe we geue thankes: yea, vnto thee doe we geue thankes.
Thy name alſo is ſo nye: and that doe thy wonderous workes declare.
When I receiue the congregacion: I ſhal iudge accordyng vnto right.
The earth is weake, and all the inhabitours therof: I beare vp the pillers of it.
I ſayed vnto the fooles, deale not ſo madly: and to the vngodly, ſet not vp your horne.
Sette not vp youre horne on hye: and ſpeake not with a ſtiffe necke.
For promocion commeth neither from the Eaſt, nor from the Weſt: nor yet from the Southe.
And why? GOD is the iudge: he putteth downe one and ſetteth vp an other.
For in the hande of the Lorde there is a cup, and the wine is red: it is full mixte, and he poureth out of theſame.
As for the dregges therof: all the vngodly of the yearth ſhall drinke them, and ſucke them out.
But I will talke of the God of Iacob: and prayſe hym for euer.
All the hornes of the vngodly alſo will I breake: and the hornes of the righteous ſhalbe exalted.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning, is nowe, and euer. &c.
